Theory policy:
 - C6 acceptance is native-structural for degree-7 simple-knot B-spline and equality-constrained for Power/Bezier; floating join/end residuals are diagnostics.
 - All three methods solve exact seventh-derivative energy in square-root form; no Q/Hessian normal-equation solve.
 - QR uses the structurally full-row-rank equality system; no SVD rank truncation or artificial ridge.
 - v/a/j are conservative Bernstein bounds and are measurement only.
 - Geometry certificate is conservative/sufficient finite-direction Bernstein support certification, not exact global distance.
 - Positive cable-tension lower bound is reported and gated separately from geometric separation.
 - Search logs retain one representative failed candidate; every candidate row remains in result for offline analysis.
 - condCZ(coord) and optCoeffCorrection are coordinate-space numerical diagnostics; they must not be interpreted as basis-independent physical quality metrics.

 - G1 removes the fixed duration and fixed rejoin endpoint from the decision itself.
 - The current discrete T landmarks are for characterization of the rejoin/time trade-off; they are not yet the final continuous/adaptive T solver.
 - Pareto dominance is used only to identify non-dominated feasible candidates; no arbitrary scalar weights are introduced.
 - High speed alone is not treated as payload swing. a, j, cable angle/rate, J7 and input usage are reported separately.
 - Runtime optimization/F2C/F2D remains deferred; obvious repeated front-end work is already avoided by reusing the trigger state.
 - G1 diagnostic errors are printed explicitly; a NaN row must not be interpreted as physical infeasibility without the error field.

Implementation order for T7+:

  T7-B : ITERATIVE_LOCAL_REALLOCATION first, because it can reuse the existing piecewise Bezier export directly.

 - Fast-Planner/EGO-style local reallocation is structurally closest to the current piecewise trajectory representation.
 - Gao-style path-time mapping requires non-affine chain-rule derivatives and must be implemented carefully for suspended-load moments.
 - Joint optimization changes both path and time, so it should be last after the common feasibility kernel is trusted.

For every T_new>0, physical-time C6 at a replan handoff requires:
    d^k p_new/ds_new^k (0) = T_new^k * d^k p_old/dt^k (t_h),  k=0,...,6.

 - The planner begins with zero obstacle knowledge and cannot query the environment directly.
 - Detection alone does not switch the reference; future collision on the CURRENT reference is required.
 - Sensing remains active during avoidance; NEW/model-changed threats can cause a recursive C6 replan.
 - Same-model known obstacles do not retrigger while their currently executing trajectory is already certified.
 - yaw = cached degree-27 C6 fit to the executing horizontal tangent (progress direction).
 - Every accepted switch preserves the measured current physical-time d0..d6 start jet by construction.
 - Hard safety authority in B3 is the time-cell swept-support halfspace certificate for the vertical-cable geometry proxy.
 - No claim is made here for nonlinear cable swing dynamics, HLC tracking, thrust/moment feasibility, CBF or closed-loop safety.

[B3 INTERPRETATION]
 - The planner begins with zero obstacle knowledge and cannot query the environment directly.
 - Detection alone does not switch the reference; future collision on the CURRENT reference is required.
 - Sensing remains active during avoidance; NEW/model-changed threats can cause a recursive C6 replan.
 - Same-model known obstacles do not retrigger while their currently executing trajectory is already certified.
 - yaw = cached degree-27 C6 fit to the executing horizontal tangent (progress direction).
 - Every accepted switch preserves the measured current physical-time d0..d6 start jet by construction.
 - Hard safety authority in V16 is component-wise swept-support certification for PAYLOAD/UAV/CABLE; no global system convex hull is used.
 - No claim is made here for nonlinear cable swing dynamics, HLC tracking, thrust/moment feasibility, CBF or closed-loop safety.

 - The planner begins with zero obstacle knowledge and cannot query the environment directly.
 - Detection alone does not switch the reference; future collision on the CURRENT reference is required.
 - Sensing remains active during avoidance; NEW/model-changed threats can cause a recursive C6 replan.
 - Same-model known obstacles do not retrigger while their currently executing trajectory is already certified.
 - yaw = cached degree-27 C6 fit to the executing horizontal tangent (progress direction).
 - Every accepted switch preserves the measured current physical-time d0..d6 start jet by construction.
 - Hard safety authority in V16 is component-wise swept-support certification for PAYLOAD/UAV/CABLE; no global system convex hull is used.
 - No claim is made here for nonlinear cable swing dynamics, HLC tracking, thrust/moment feasibility, CBF or closed-loop safety.

[EXEC] dt=0.025 s | sensor=30.000 Hz | predictor=5.000 s / 11 samples
[SCOPE] vertical-cable geometry proxy L=2 m; controller tracking/dynamics are NOT claimed in B3.
[LEAKAGE GUARD] ground truth is accessed only inside the internal depth-camera section of this one-file validator.
[V5 CHANGE] only embedded obstacle placement changed to intersect the current +x mission/camera FOV; planner/sensor logic unchanged.
[V6 CHANGE] removed mathematically impossible duration fixed-point; nominal-speed detour ratio is diagnostic only in B3.
[V7 CHANGE] canonical replan-event struct schema synchronized with planner output.
[V8 CHANGE] hard-certificate criteria unchanged; exact failing component(s) are printed.
[V9 CHANGE] infeasible QP is decomposed by fixed-row test + Phase-I minimum uniform relaxation.
[V10 CHANGE] corridor halfspaces are exact SOCP max-margin separators that contain mandatory C6 boundary-control-point seed sets.
[V11 CHANGE] separator feasibility uses primal convex-set distance; cheap certified reject precedes SOCP/QP; stage runtimes are logged.
[V12 CHANGE] exact redundancy removal + coneprog solver fallback + detailed sensor/planner stage profiling + isolated kernel tests.
[V13 CHANGE] planner memory is built ONLY from depth-hit observation cells; full ground-truth obstacle center/radii/orientation are not exported by the sensor.
[V14 CHANGE] progressively observed surfaces are stored as exact nonredundant ellipsoid patches; replanning is event-driven by genuinely new observed volume; towing risk logs PAYLOAD/UAV/CABLE separately.
[V15 CHANGE] coneprog exit flag is no longer the safety authority; every candidate normal is independently certified by exact convex support separation. Cell-wise seed/ellipsoid diagnostics added.
[V16 CHANGE] full-system convex-hull inflation removed from production corridor construction; PAYLOAD/UAV/CABLE are certified separately with component-specific forbidden sets.
[V17 CHANGE] the bypass construction normal is tested first as an exact support-function witness; SOCP is used only when that analytic witness cannot certify the cell. No empirical extra offset is added.
[V18 CHANGE] nominal rejoin time is made C6-boundary-aware: the furthest backward endpoint control point of all retained backends must clear every observed component forbidden set before backend trajectory generation.
[V19 CHANGE] minimal dynamic layer: exact Bernstein convex-hull certificates for velocity/acceleration after generation; jerk..d6 are diagnostic only. No arbitrary physical limits are invented.

 - The planner begins with zero obstacle knowledge and cannot query the environment directly.
 - Detection alone does not switch the reference; future collision on the CURRENT reference is required.
 - Sensing remains active during avoidance; NEW/model-changed threats can cause a recursive C6 replan.
 - Same-model known obstacles do not retrigger while their currently executing trajectory is already certified.
 - yaw = cached degree-27 C6 fit to the executing horizontal tangent (progress direction).
 - Every accepted switch preserves the measured current physical-time d0..d6 start jet by construction.
 - Hard safety authority is component-wise support certification for PAYLOAD/UAV/CABLE plus C6; rejoin is spatial and nominal continuation is time-shifted.
 - Velocity/acceleration and d1..d6 bounds are advisory diagnostics only; hard acceptance remains observed-obstacle safety + C6.
 - No claim is yet made for nonlinear cable swing dynamics, thrust/moment feasibility, CBF or closed-loop safety.

[V10 CHANGE] corridor halfspaces are exact SOCP max-margin separators that contain mandatory C6 boundary-control-point seed sets.
[V11 CHANGE] separator feasibility uses primal convex-set distance; cheap certified reject precedes SOCP/QP; stage runtimes are logged.
[V12 CHANGE] exact redundancy removal + coneprog solver fallback + detailed sensor/planner stage profiling + isolated kernel tests.
[V13 CHANGE] planner memory is built ONLY from depth-hit observation cells; full ground-truth obstacle center/radii/orientation are not exported by the sensor.
[V14 CHANGE] progressively observed surfaces are stored as exact nonredundant ellipsoid patches; replanning is event-driven by genuinely new observed volume; towing risk logs PAYLOAD/UAV/CABLE separately.
[V15 CHANGE] coneprog exit flag is no longer the safety authority; every candidate normal is independently certified by exact convex support separation. Cell-wise seed/ellipsoid diagnostics added.
[V16 CHANGE] full-system convex-hull inflation removed from production corridor construction; PAYLOAD/UAV/CABLE are certified separately with component-specific forbidden sets.
[V17 CHANGE] the bypass construction normal is tested first as an exact support-function witness; SOCP is used only when that analytic witness cannot certify the cell. No empirical extra offset is added.
[V18 CHANGE] nominal rejoin time is made C6-boundary-aware: the furthest backward endpoint control point of all retained backends must clear every observed component forbidden set before backend trajectory generation.
[V19 CHANGE] minimal dynamic layer: exact Bernstein convex-hull certificates for velocity/acceleration after generation; jerk..d6 are diagnostic only. No arbitrary physical limits are invented.
[V20 CHANGE] absolute-time catch-up removed: spatial rejoin + nominal-speed path duration + time-shifted nominal continuation. HARD = safety + C6 only.
[V21 FIX] removed the final obsolete path-duration diagnostic reference; T_path_at_nominal_speed now equals the already-defined spatial-rejoin duration T.
[V22 CHANGE] boundary-QP numerical recovery is theory-based: if the returned point has negative original slack, solve max-rho interior feasibility A*y+rho<=b, rho>=0; accept only after direct original constraints are nonnegative.
[V23 CHANGE] corridor mandatory seed sets are backend-specific. D13 backends use only D13 boundary seeds; BSPLINE_D7 uses only D7 extracted-Bezier boundary seeds. Cross-backend seed convexification is removed without relaxing safety or C6.
[V22 CHANGE] yaw endpoint particular solution uses SVD pseudoinverse instead of normal equations.

[B3 INTERPRETATION]
 - The planner begins with zero obstacle knowledge and cannot query the environment directly.
 - Detection alone does not switch the reference; future collision on the CURRENT reference is required.
 - Sensing remains active during avoidance; NEW/model-changed threats can cause a recursive C6 replan.
 - Same-model known obstacles do not retrigger while their currently executing trajectory is already certified.
 - yaw = cached degree-27 C6 fit to the executing horizontal tangent (progress direction).
 - Every accepted switch preserves the measured current physical-time d0..d6 start jet by construction.
 - Hard safety authority is component-wise support certification for PAYLOAD/UAV/CABLE plus C6; rejoin is spatial and nominal continuation is time-shifted.
 - Velocity/acceleration and d1..d6 bounds are advisory diagnostics only; hard acceptance remains observed-obstacle safety + C6.
 - No claim is yet made for nonlinear cable swing dynamics, thrust/moment feasibility, CBF or closed-loop safety.

 - The planner begins with zero obstacle knowledge and cannot query the environment directly.
 - Detection alone does not switch the reference; future collision on the CURRENT reference is required.
 - Sensing remains active during avoidance; NEW/model-changed threats can cause a recursive C6 replan.
 - Same-model known obstacles do not retrigger while their currently executing trajectory is already certified.
 - yaw = cached degree-27 C6 fit to the executing horizontal tangent (progress direction).
 - Every accepted switch preserves the measured current physical-time d0..d6 start jet by construction.
 - Hard safety authority is component-wise support certification for PAYLOAD/UAV/CABLE plus C6; rejoin is spatial and nominal continuation is time-shifted.
 - Velocity/acceleration and d1..d6 bounds are advisory diagnostics only; hard acceptance remains observed-obstacle safety + C6.

[B3 INTERPRETATION]
 - The planner begins with zero obstacle knowledge and cannot query the environment directly.
 - Detection alone does not switch the reference; future collision on the CURRENT reference is required.
 - Sensing remains active during avoidance; NEW/model-changed threats can cause a recursive C6 replan.
 - Same-model known obstacles do not retrigger while their currently executing trajectory is already certified.
 - yaw = cached degree-27 C6 fit to the executing horizontal tangent (progress direction).
 - Every accepted switch preserves the measured current physical-time d0..d6 start jet by construction.
 - Hard safety authority is component-wise support certification for PAYLOAD/UAV/CABLE plus C6; rejoin is spatial and nominal continuation is time-shifted.
 - Guide-cell containment is diagnostic only; actual restricted curve-hull constraints and full-row direct checks are the safety authority.
 - Velocity/acceleration and d1..d6 bounds are advisory diagnostics only; hard acceptance remains observed-obstacle safety + C6.
 - No claim is yet made for nonlinear cable swing dynamics, thrust/moment feasibility, CBF or closed-loop safety.

[B3 INTERPRETATION]
 - The planner begins with zero obstacle knowledge and cannot query the environment directly.
 - Detection alone does not switch the reference; future collision on the CURRENT reference is required.
 - Sensing remains active during avoidance; NEW/model-changed threats can cause a recursive C6 replan.
 - Same-model known obstacles do not retrigger while their currently executing trajectory is already certified.
 - yaw = cached degree-27 C6 fit to the executing horizontal tangent (progress direction).
 - Every accepted switch preserves the measured current physical-time d0..d6 start jet by construction.
 - Hard safety authority is C6 plus component-wise PAYLOAD/UAV/CABLE support; V37 adds a continuous acceleration-induced rigid-cable q-cone post-certificate before switch.
 - Guide-cell containment is diagnostic only; actual restricted curve-hull constraints and full-row direct checks are the safety authority.
 - Velocity/acceleration and d1..d6 bounds are advisory diagnostics only; hard acceptance remains observed-obstacle safety + C6.
 - V41 rebuilds rigid-cable separators directly from actual local q-cone geometry; old vertical-proxy halfspaces are not the final dynamic safety authority.
 - V40/V41 remain trajectory-modification-only: supplied tracking/model error bounds are absorbed by exact Minkowski support inflation before trajectory acceptance.
 - Unspecified error bounds are never silently inferred from RMSE or nominal margins and remain explicitly NOT guaranteed.

 - The planner begins with zero obstacle knowledge and cannot query the environment directly.
 - Detection alone does not switch the reference; future collision on the CURRENT reference is required.
 - Sensing remains active during avoidance; NEW/model-changed threats can cause a recursive C6 replan.
 - Same-model known obstacles do not retrigger while their currently executing trajectory is already certified.
 - yaw = cached degree-27 C6 fit to the executing horizontal tangent (progress direction).
 - Every accepted switch preserves the measured current physical-time d0..d6 start jet by construction.
 - Hard safety authority is C6 plus component-wise PAYLOAD/UAV/CABLE support; V37 adds a continuous acceleration-induced rigid-cable p-cone post-certificate before switch.
 - Guide-cell containment is diagnostic only; actual restricted curve-hull constraints and full-row direct checks are the safety authority.
 - Velocity/acceleration and d1..d6 bounds are advisory diagnostics only; hard acceptance remains observed-obstacle safety + C6.
 - V42 enforces exact coordinate identities: p_Q=p_L-Lq implies forbidden payload-center shift +Lp, and SOCP distance uses MATLAB ||A*x-b|| with b=c0, giving pS-pF=D*x-c0.
 - Analytic PAYLOAD/UAV/CABLE identity tests must pass before mission execution, so adaptive subdivision cannot hide sign/model regressions.
 - V40/V41 remain trajectory-modification-only: supplied tracking/model error bounds are absorbed by exact Minkowski support inflation before trajectory acceptance.
 - Unspecified error bounds are never silently inferred from RMSE or nominal margins and remain explicitly NOT guaranteed.

 - The planner begins with zero obstacle knowledge and cannot query the environment directly.
 - Detection alone does not switch the reference; future collision on the CURRENT reference is required.
 - Sensing remains active during avoidance; NEW/model-changed threats can cause a recursive C6 replan.
 - Same-model known obstacles do not retrigger while their currently executing trajectory is already certified.
 - yaw = cached degree-27 C6 fit to the executing horizontal tangent (progress direction).
 - Every accepted switch preserves the measured current physical-time d0..d6 start jet by construction.
 - Hard safety authority is C6 plus component-wise PAYLOAD/UAV/CABLE support; V37 adds a continuous acceleration-induced rigid-cable p-cone post-certificate before switch.
 - Guide-cell containment is diagnostic only; actual restricted curve-hull constraints and full-row direct checks are the safety authority.
 - Velocity/acceleration and d1..d6 bounds are advisory diagnostics only; hard acceptance remains observed-obstacle safety + C6.
 - V42 enforces exact coordinate identities: p_Q=p_L-Lq implies forbidden payload-center shift +Lp, and SOCP distance uses MATLAB ||A*x-b|| with b=c0, giving pS-pF=D*x-c0.
 - Analytic PAYLOAD/UAV/CABLE identity tests must pass before mission execution, so adaptive subdivision cannot hide sign/model regressions.
 - V40/V41 remain trajectory-modification-only: supplied tracking/model error bounds are absorbed by exact Minkowski support inflation before trajectory acceptance.
 - Unspecified error bounds are never silently inferred from RMSE or nominal margins and remain explicitly NOT guaranteed.

[V54 RUNTIME AUDIT] no safety logic changed: every dynamic SOCP is logged by cell/span/depth/obstacle-patch/component, with exact prior-normal reuse counterfactual and per-call timing.
[V55 FASTPATH] exact previous normal for the same obstacle-patch/component is checked by the SAME direct support certificate before SOCP; if certified, SOCP is skipped with no safety-authority change.
[V56 CASCADE] precomputed axis normals + one analytic center-direction witness are checked by exact CURRENT support before cache/SOCP; the same cascade is used in corridor construction.
[V56 OFFLINE/ONLINE] fixed separator directions, yaw endpoint matrix, and repeated 0.5 de-Casteljau split maps are cached/precomputed; validation-only dense audits remain outside ONLINE timing.

[B3 INTERPRETATION]
 - The planner begins with zero obstacle knowledge and cannot query the environment directly.
 - Detection alone does not switch the reference; future collision on the CURRENT reference is required.
 - Sensing remains active during avoidance; NEW/model-changed threats can cause a recursive C6 replan.
 - Same-model known obstacles do not retrigger while their currently executing trajectory is already certified.
 - yaw = cached degree-27 C6 fit to the executing horizontal tangent (progress direction).
 - Every accepted switch preserves the measured current physical-time d0..d6 start jet by construction.
 - Hard safety authority is C6 plus component-wise PAYLOAD/UAV/CABLE support; V37 adds a continuous acceleration-induced rigid-cable p-cone post-certificate before switch.
 - Guide-cell containment is diagnostic only; actual restricted curve-hull constraints and full-row direct checks are the safety authority.
 - Velocity/acceleration and d1..d6 bounds are advisory diagnostics only; hard acceptance remains observed-obstacle safety + C6.
 - V42 enforces exact coordinate identities: p_Q=p_L-Lq implies forbidden payload-center shift +Lp, and SOCP distance uses MATLAB ||A*x-b|| with b=c0, giving pS-pF=D*x-c0.
 - Analytic PAYLOAD/UAV/CABLE identity tests must pass before mission execution, so adaptive subdivision cannot hide sign/model regressions.
 - V40/V41 remain trajectory-modification-only: supplied tracking/model error bounds are absorbed by exact Minkowski support inflation before trajectory acceptance.
 - Unspecified error bounds are never silently inferred from RMSE or nominal margins and remain explicitly NOT guaranteed.

[B3 INTERPRETATION]
 - The planner begins with zero obstacle knowledge and cannot query the environment directly.
 - Detection alone does not switch the reference; future collision on the CURRENT reference is required.
 - Sensing remains active during avoidance; NEW/model-changed threats can cause a recursive C6 replan.
 - Same-model known obstacles do not retrigger while their currently executing trajectory is already certified.
 - yaw = cached degree-27 C6 fit to the executing horizontal tangent (progress direction).
 - Every accepted switch preserves the measured current physical-time d0..d6 start jet by construction.
 - Hard safety authority is C6 plus component-wise PAYLOAD/UAV/CABLE support; V37 adds a continuous acceleration-induced rigid-cable p-cone post-certificate before switch.
 - Guide-cell containment is diagnostic only; actual restricted curve-hull constraints and full-row direct checks are the safety authority.
 - Velocity/acceleration and d1..d6 bounds are advisory diagnostics only; hard acceptance remains observed-obstacle safety + C6.
 - V42 enforces exact coordinate identities: p_Q=p_L-Lq implies forbidden payload-center shift +Lp, and SOCP distance uses MATLAB ||A*x-b|| with b=c0, giving pS-pF=D*x-c0.
 - Analytic PAYLOAD/UAV/CABLE identity tests must pass before mission execution, so adaptive subdivision cannot hide sign/model regressions.
 - V40/V41 remain trajectory-modification-only: supplied tracking/model error bounds are absorbed by exact Minkowski support inflation before trajectory acceptance.
 - Unspecified error bounds are never silently inferred from RMSE or nominal margins and remain explicitly NOT guaranteed.
